extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n for real n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1); extends to any real exponent.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is constant and f is differentiable, d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[f(x)+g(x)] = f'(x)+g'(x) for differentiable f and g.

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[f(x)-g(x)] = f'(x)-g'(x) for differentiable f and g.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The instantaneous rate of change of a function; computed by differentiation rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of computing derivatives; inverse of antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property of a function being differentiable, required by the differentiation rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions built from powers x^n with positive integer exponents; differentiated term-by-term via the Power Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function a^x with derivative d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: e^x is its own derivative: d/dx(e^x) = e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Euler's Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Appears in d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Used to define e via lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1; underlies the derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function s(t) whose derivative gives velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of position: v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of velocity and second derivative of position: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of the derivative, e.g., acceleration s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Economic cost function whose derivative is marginal cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of the cost function: MC = C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative interpreted as a rate of change, linking to physics, biology, economics.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation of differentiation (integration).

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation (integration).
